content.text: Submitted. The repaired insertion now states the preferred literals expressly — "up to 6 months at TrueLink's then-current rates", "within 30 days after such expiration or termination", and "standard machine-readable format" — with deletion and written certification after return, and drops the non-target qualifiers ("reasonable", "in TrueLink's possession or control", "including borrower and loan data"). Status remains missing at the preferred level.
